##### Project general facts

Acacia by BNW Developments is a refined waterfront residence set on the prestigious shores of Al Marjan Island, where island serenity meets contemporary architectural elegance. The project offers a curated selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, along with exclusive 4-bedroom penthouses, all designed with flowing layouts, expansive glazing, and seamless indoor-outdoor connection. Its sophisticated design embraces panoramic sea views, natural light, and open living concepts, creating a calm yet stylish environment shaped by modern coastal living.

Residents enjoy a thoughtfully curated range of resort-style amenities designed for both relaxation and social living. Infinity swimming pools, a fully equipped gym with sea views, landscaped gardens, and viewing decks create a wellness-focused atmosphere, while family-friendly features such as kids’ pools, play areas, and barbecue zones enhance everyday comfort. A signature restaurant, café, and elegant lounge spaces complete the lifestyle offering, bringing convenience and leisure together within a vibrant seaside community.

Interiors reflect a refined balance of elegance and comfort, finished with modern high-quality materials and a sophisticated design palette. Kitchens come fully equipped with built-in appliances, ensuring functionality and style, while living spaces are crafted to feel both inviting and luxurious. The residences are offered fully furnished, allowing for a seamless move-in experience where every detail is carefully considered to enhance contemporary coastal living.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Marjan Island is a stunning man-made archipelago located in the emirate of Ras Al Khaimah. It is one of the most prominent tourist destinations in the region, known for its picturesque beaches, luxurious resorts, and upscale residential developments. Al Marjan Island is situated along the Arabian Gulf coastline and offers breathtaking views of the sea. The island is shaped like a coral reef and is made up of four primary coral-shaped islands, connected by a central boulevard.

One of the main highlights of Al Marjan Island is its pristine white sandy beaches that stretch across 5.4 kilometers. Visitors can indulge in various beach activities, including sunbathing, swimming, and water sports such as jet skiing and paddleboarding. The crystal-clear waters of the Arabian Gulf provide an ideal setting for water enthusiasts.

Al Marjan Island boasts a collection of luxurious hotels and resorts, offering world-class amenities and services. These accommodations cater to both leisure and business travelers, providing a range of options to suit different preferences and budgets. Many of the hotels and resorts on the island feature stunning architecture and provide access to private beaches, swimming pools, spas, and gourmet dining options.
